thread:
Ana (PM): quick sync — want to lock the onboarding -> tier entry flow before we freeze the Q3 pricing ship. thoughts?
Matt (Product Ops): yes. main ask from sales: simpler path from trial to microcommit. customers get confused by credits + slab quotas.
Ryan (Pricing): agree. proposal: trial credits -> 30-day microcommit (soft cap) -> auto-upgrade prompt if 7-day avg > 60% of soft cap.
Jess (Sales): +1. also need an escape hatch for enterprise pilots to bypass soft cap during demo week.
Ana (PM): ok. what are launch gating criteria? metrics + legal/compliance checks?
Ryan (Pricing): minimum gating: (1) conversion from trial to paid >= 6%, (2) < 4% support tickets about billing flow, (3) cost-per-activated-user within budgeted LTV assumptions.
Matt (Product Ops): operational gating: rollout to 10 pilot accounts, telemetry validated (rate limit + per-route latency), alerting triggers in Console.
Jess (Sales): for pilots we need a signed MSA template variation that allows burst during pilot. legal-bot: flagged — need clause for temporary capacity exceptions + expiration. I can draft.
Ana (PM): scope negotiation: do we include a low-cost "surge pack" add-on at GA or wait for pilot signals?
Ryan (Pricing): prefer wait. add-on complexity increases trials. but create a disabled UI slot to enable quickly if pilot demand spikes.
Matt (Product Ops): technical note — surge packs require priority routing and dedicated queue tokens. infra estimate: ~3w to wire in canary path.
Jess (Sales): timeline ok if we ship pilot enablement now. can we get a playbook for sales to request temporary surge?
Ana (PM): action items: Ryan draft tier gating KPIs, Matt make a technical checklist + estimated lead times, legal-bot to propose MSA pilot clause. Jess will identify 8 pilot customers.
Ryan (Pricing): drafting KPIs now, will post in this thread by EOD.
Matt (Product Ops): adding infra checklist to #eng-platform and linking here once done.
legal-bot: uploaded draft clause to drive:link/msa-pilot-clause (internal).
Jess (Sales): pinging @partners to line up pilots.
Ana (PM): last question — do we lock per-route throughput add-on for GA? seems risky.
Ryan (Pricing): defer to later. keep GA add-ons: priority lane (concept) + surge pack (merchant only once validated).
Matt (Product Ops): note: make the add-on feature-flagged so we can enable per-customer without code deploy. saves ops time.
Ana (PM): perfect. closing — we'll revisit scope after pilot metrics. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
